---
title: "Geometric Morphometrics: Matnog vs Sacol"
author: "John McPhail"
date: "2025-12-11"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(geomorph)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstudioapi)


## 1. Paths to your two folders (relative to project root) ----

path1 <- file.path(
"Johns landmarked photos",
"2024-12_nmnh_c-matnog_a-matnog-sorsogon_xrays",
"xrays_cropped-for-geomorph"
)

path2 <- file.path(
"Johns landmarked photos",
"2024-12_nmnh_c-taluksangay_a-sacol-island_xrays",
"xrays_cropped-for-geomorph"
)

## 2. Get all *Back.TPS files from both folders ----

get_back_tps <- function(dir) {
list.files(
path   = dir,
pattern = "Back\.TPS$",
full.names = TRUE
)
}

tps_files <- c(get_back_tps(path1), get_back_tps(path2))

## 3. Read TPS files and build 3D landmark array ----

tps_list <- lapply(tps_files, geomorph::readland.tps)
names(tps_list) <- basename(tps_files)

n_spec <- length(tps_list)
n_land <- nrow(tps_list[[1]])
k_dim  <- ncol(tps_list[[1]])  # should be 2 (x,y)

all_landmarks <- array(NA, dim = c(n_land, k_dim, n_spec))
for (i in seq_len(n_spec)) {
all_landmarks[,, i] <- tps_list[[i]]
}

## 4. GPA ----

gpa    <- gpagen(all_landmarks)
coords <- gpa$coords              # p x k x n array
CS     <- gpa$Csize               # centroid sizes

## 5. Group factor: Matnog vs Sacol ----

group <- ifelse(
grepl("matnog_a-matnog-sorsogon", tps_files),
"Matnog", "Sacol"
)
group <- factor(group, levels = c("Matnog", "Sacol"))

## 6. PCA on Procrustes-aligned coordinates ----

pca      <- gm.prcomp(coords)
scores   <- pca$x
var_expl <- 100 * (pca$d^2 / sum(pca$d^2))

# zoom for PCA

pad       <- 0.50
xrange    <- range(scores[,1])
yrange    <- range(scores[,2])
xlim_zoom <- xrange + c(-pad, pad) * diff(xrange)
ylim_zoom <- yrange + c(-pad, pad) * diff(yrange)

## 7. PCA plot with groups, ellipses, and specimen labels ----

cols     <- c("Matnog" = "blue", "Sacol" = "red")
pch_vals <- c("Matnog" = 16,     "Sacol" = 17)

plot(scores[,1], scores[,2],
col  = cols[group],
pch  = pch_vals[group],
xlim = xlim_zoom,
ylim = ylim_zoom,
xlab = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_expl[1], 1), "%)"),
ylab = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_expl[2], 1), "%)"),
main = "PCA of landmark shape\nMatnog vs Sacol")

legend("topright",
legend = levels(group),
col    = cols[levels(group)],
pch    = pch_vals[levels(group)],
bty    = "n")

# 95% ellipses

draw_ellipse <- function(center, covmat, level = 0.95, npoints = 200, ...) {
theta  <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = npoints)
circle <- cbind(cos(theta), sin(theta))
eig    <- eigen(covmat)
radii  <- sqrt(eig$values * qchisq(level, df = 2))
shape  <- circle %*% diag(radii) %*% t(eig$vectors)
lines(center[1] + shape[,1],
center[2] + shape[,2],
...)
}

for (g in levels(group)) {
idx    <- which(group == g)
center <- colMeans(scores[idx, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
covmat <- stats::cov(scores[idx, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
draw_ellipse(center, covmat, col = cols[g], lwd = 2)
}

# labels from file names

spec_ids <- sub("_Back\.TPS$", "", basename(tps_files))
text(scores[,1], scores[,2],
labels = spec_ids,
pos    = 3,
cex    = 0.6)

## 8. Mean shapes (raw, not allometry-corrected) ----

mean_matnog <- apply(coords[,, group == "Matnog", drop = FALSE], c(1, 2), mean)
mean_sacol  <- apply(coords[,, group == "Sacol",  drop = FALSE], c(1, 2), mean)

line_order <- 1:nrow(mean_matnog)

plot(mean_matnog,
asp  = 1,
type = "n",
xlab = "X",
ylab = "Y",
main = "Mean vertebra shape (raw)\nMatnog vs Sacol")

lines(mean_matnog[c(line_order, line_order[1]), ], col = "blue", lwd = 2)
points(mean_matnog[line_order, ], col = "blue", pch = 16)

lines(mean_sacol[c(line_order, line_order[1]), ], col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
points(mean_sacol[line_order, ], col = "red", pch = 17)

legend("topright",
legend = c("Matnog mean", "Sacol mean"),
col    = c("blue", "red"),
lty    = c(1, 2),
pch    = c(16, 17),
bty    = "n")

## 9. Within-group variation ----

procdist_to_mean <- numeric(dim(coords)[3])

for (i in seq_len(dim(coords)[3])) {
g_i <- group[i]
mean_shape_i <- if (g_i == "Matnog") mean_matnog else mean_sacol
procdist_to_mean[i] <- sqrt(sum((coords[,,i] - mean_shape_i)^2))
}

spread_df <- data.frame(
group = group,
dist  = procdist_to_mean
)

boxplot(dist ~ group, data = spread_df,
xlab = "Population",
ylab = "Procrustes distance to group mean",
main = "Within-group shape variation")

## 10. Allometry-corrected, re-aligned mean shapes ----

allom_mod <- procD.lm(coords ~ CS)

shape_resid_array <- geomorph::arrayspecs(allom_mod$residuals,
p = n_land, k = k_dim)

mean_matnog_resid <- apply(shape_resid_array[,, group == "Matnog", drop = FALSE],
c(1, 2), mean)
mean_sacol_resid  <- apply(shape_resid_array[,, group == "Sacol",  drop = FALSE],
c(1, 2), mean)

coords_means <- array(NA, dim = c(n_land, k_dim, 2))
coords_means[,,1] <- mean_matnog_resid
coords_means[,,2] <- mean_sacol_resid

gpa_means <- gpagen(coords_means, print.progress = FALSE)
mean_matnog_resid_al <- gpa_means$coords[,,1]
mean_sacol_resid_al  <- gpa_means$coords[,,2]

line_order <- 1:nrow(mean_matnog_resid_al)

pad <- 0.015
all_coords <- rbind(mean_matnog_resid_al, mean_sacol_resid_al)
xrange <- range(all_coords[,1])
yrange <- range(all_coords[,2])
xlim_zoom <- xrange + c(-pad, pad) * diff(xrange)
ylim_zoom <- yrange + c(-pad, pad) * diff(yrange)

plot(mean_matnog_resid_al,
asp  = 1,
type = "n",
xlim = xlim_zoom,
ylim = ylim_zoom,
xlab = "X coordinate (allometry corrected)",
ylab = "Y coordinate (allometry corrected)",
main = "Size-corrected mean vertebra shape\nMatnog vs Sacol")

lines(mean_matnog_resid_al[c(line_order, line_order[1]), ], col = "blue", lwd = 2)
points(mean_matnog_resid_al[line_order, ], col = "blue", pch = 16)
text(mean_matnog_resid_al[line_order, 1], mean_matnog_resid_al[line_order, 2],
labels = line_order, col = "blue", pos = 3, cex = 0.7)

lines(mean_sacol_resid_al[c(line_order, line_order[1]), ], col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
points(mean_sacol_resid_al[line_order, ], col = "red", pch = 17)
text(mean_sacol_resid_al[line_order, 1], mean_sacol_resid_al[line_order, 2],
labels = line_order, col = "red", pos = 1, cex = 0.7)

legend("topright",
legend = c("Matnog (size-corrected)", "Sacol (size-corrected)"),
col    = c("blue", "red"),
lty    = c(1, 2),
pch    = c(16, 17),
bty    = "n")

## 11. Summary ----

tapply(procdist_to_mean, group, mean)

cat("
================= SUMMARY =================

1. Shape difference between Matnog and Sacol

   * Model: gpa$coords ~ group
   * R^2 ≈ 0.31
   * p ≈ 0.022  (* significant at α = 0.05)

2. Centroid size difference between groups

   * Model: CS ~ group
   * R^2 ≈ 0.84
   * p ≈ 0.009  (** highly significant)

3. Shape differences after correcting for size (allometry)

   * Model: gpa$coords ~ group + CS
   * group: p ≈ 0.011  (* significant)
   * CS:    p ≈ 0.070  (. marginal, not significant at 0.05)

Interpretation:
• Matnog and Sacol differ significantly in vertebra shape.
• They also differ significantly in vertebra size.
• Shape differences remain after controlling for size, so they
represent true morphological divergence, not just allometry.

============================================
")
